buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK/ATC 1. Tender is for procurement of Laundry Service (Pickup & Drop) for Premium, Executive & Standard Guest House s of LIC of India, situated at address 16/275, M.G. Road Civil Lines , Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, Pin-208001. 2. The period of contract will be initially for one year from the date of commencement of services/ work and can be extended for furthur two years (one year at a time) subject to mutual consent o f both the parties with same rates and terms and conditions.

3. The bidder must have a Laundry shop/Worksite and office in “Kanpur Nagar” with proper documentary evid ence for faster & better serviceability, with a responsible personnel. 4. The exact requirement of no of items for Laundry Service could not be assessed by LIC before ente ring into the contract. Thus it will be a Rate Contract and payment will be made for per items/piece basis sent for laundry service. 5. There is no Minimum Business Guarantee offered by the Buyer during the Contact Period. 6. Bidders should quote for financial bid inclusive all taxes and other costs (Pickup & Drop Service). 7. The estimated quantity of linen/cloth mentioned in the bid(Table-A) is indicative in nature viz. quantity of a line n item likely to be washed over a one year period. Payment shall however be made on a monthly basis on the basis of actual number of linen/clothes washed. Table-A Total No of pieces sent Sl N Details of Laundry Item Type of Service for Laundry Service (LY o ) 1 Single Bedsheet Wet Cleaning & Ironing 1561 2 Double Bedsheet Wet Cleaning & Ironing 179 3 Pillow cover Wet Cleaning & Ironing 1298 4 Bath Towel Wet Cleaning 1004 5 Hand Towel Wet Cleaning 216 6 Blanket cover Wet Cleaning 2 7 Blanket Single Bed double Layer Wet Cleaning 33 8 Blanket Single Bed double Layer Dry Cleaning 0 9 Curtain Standard Size Wet Cleaning & Ironing 68 10 Sofa Cover Set (3 seater) Wet Cleaning 0 11 Sofa Cover Set (Single Seater) Wet Cleaning 0 12 Office Chair Wet cleaning 0 8. The items for washing should be taken by the launderer after mentioning the details in the concerned Register maintained for this purpose by OS Department. 9. Wear and tear if any should be noticed during the collection and must be pointed out to the department. Defect if any found later on will be the responsibility of the successful bidder. 10. The Service Provider shall process linen/cloths and other laundry items as per care label/ washing instructions/ best washing. 11. The Service Provider shall sort, process used linen/clothes and other laundry items with standard laundering pr ocesses including repairing (if required), finishing and transportation and delivery of washed linen / clothes and other laundry items shall be in a proper way as per the schedule /timing agreed between LIC and the service pr

ovider. 12. At any stage in the washing process, the Service Provider is liable for replacement of the damaged linen/cloths and other laundry items with new one of same quality. 13. If the quality of the washed linen/clothes and other laundry items are not found to be complying with the stipul ations defined by LIC, the same shall be rewashed and will also be treated as a violation of terms and condition s 14. Corporation reserves the right to cancel or terminate this contract / agreement by giving one month’s notice in writing without giving or assigning any reasons whatsoever for doing so. In the event of the Contractor wishing to terminate this Contract, the Contractor shall give at least three months’ notice to Corporation in writing and in either case; the Contractor shall hand over the peaceful possession of the space as provided in the tender. The Agency has to provide the Laundry Service till the next agency is engaged (in case of termination of contra ct). 15. The bidder shall indemnify and hold the LIC protected/safe from and against all claims, damages, loses and exp enses arising out of, or resulting from the works/services under the contract provided by the service provider. 16. In the event that the Life Insurance Corporation of India is held liable under any law to pay any compensation, damages, or other amount to any employee, workman, agent, or personnel of the Bidder on account of any inj ury, disability, illness, accident, or death caused or sustained during the course of or arising out of the perform ance of duties at or in connection with the premises of the Corporation, the bidder/service provider shall fully i ndemnify the Corporation against all such claims, liabilities, payments, losses, damages, penalties, costs, charg es, and expenses, including litigation expenses and advocate’s fees incurred by the Corporation in this regard. 17. The bidder shall not cause or allow any of his personnel to act in any manner, which may cause unnecessary di sturbance or inconvenience to the Corporation, employees of the Corporation, owners / tenants / occupants of nearby properties or to the general public. 18. The bidder shall be responsible for any loss due to theft / pilferage / damage caused in the course of performan ce of duties to the Corporation’s property including fittings, furniture, fixtures or any other equipment(s). The C orporation shall assess the amount payable by the Contractor towards damages / loss / theft / pilferage and the same shall be recovered by the Corporation from the monthly payment to be made to the Contractor. 19. Courts in Kanpur alone will have exclusive jurisdiction in all matter connected with or arising out of this agreem ent. 20. Outsourcing Service provider shall handle data shared by the corporation in such manner as may be specified i n the respective agreement to be executed between the outsourcing service provider and L.I.C. 21. No change in Price structure will be allowed during the contract except/otherwise, if statutory tax/levies are ch anged by the Central/State Government through notifications/regulations. 22. The Contracting Company/Firm/agency shall not be allowed to transfer, assign, pledge or sub-contract its rights and liabilities under this contract to any other Company/Firm/Agency, whatsoever 23. The Service Provider shall use standard quality detergent and chemicals only. The detergent/chemicals used sh all be environment friendly and suitable for fabric. 24. The laundry should be dropped back to the pickup place within 3 days from the date of pick up. 25. The weekly frequency of visit may change as per requirement of the Office. 26. Service provider has to ensure that there is no inter change of Laundry of LIC with Laundry of other Costumers of Service provider. 27. Service provider has to ensure that Monthly Invoice is raised as per maintained log-book. 28. Bidder should take the laundry clothes/items and return them after washing/dry cleaning and ironing timely. In case of urgent work, your personnel should come immediately on our telephonic request to collect the clothes/i tems and arrange early washing. 29. Loss/Damage to any clothes or property of LIC Guest house shall be replaced by the agency immediately at the ir own expenses. 30. If the performance continoues to be unsatisfactory even after giving a notice for putting the things in order for satisfactory performance, the contract is liable to be terminated.

31. Terms and Conditions or clauses not covered in this document: Any other terms & conditions or clause not cov ered in this document shall be in accordance with the concerned Labour and other statutory rules/acts and Ge M Service Level Agreement. PAYMENT TERMS :- 1. The payment shall be made on a monthly basis on the basis of actual number of linen/clothes washed and as per th e financial quotes submitted by the Service Provider. No advance payment shall be made to the Service provider 2. The price quoted shall cover all aspects of service delivery, it shall be Inclusive of all consumables required to provid e the service. 3. Payment of Bills shall be made only after the verification by the authorized personnel of LIC. Penality clause:- As per GeM SLA & GTC . 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of LIC OF INDIA payable at ZONAL OFFICE KANPUR . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name LIC OF INDIA Account No. 911020067317061 IFSC Code UTIB0000133 Bank Name AXIS BANK Branch address 15/179 THE MALL ROAD OPP PHOOL BAGH KANPUR 208001 . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract.
